_comment: Base TypeScript options shared by every package and app in the workspace.
apps/app/tsconfig.json and apps/web/tsconfig.json were byte-identical before U7,
which is why this extraction is a pure deduplication rather than a reconciliation.
Deliberately framework-neutral: nothing here mentions Next, the DOM or JSX, so
packages/schemas can extend it without inheriting anything that would violate P-5.
Next-specific options live in tsconfig.next.json, which the two web apps extend instead.
